name: Catalina Resources Ltd
summary: Catalina Resources Ltd. is an Australian explorer, developer and miner of mineral properties, with lithium, iron, gold and base metals as its main targets. Its interests include an iron project at Nelson Bay River in Tasmania plus the Dundas, Kookynie West and Lachlan Fold Belt projects. The company dates from 2008, is based in Nedlands, and was formerly Shree Minerals Limited.
